title: The Taxonomy of the Damp Counter
core_theme: The public humiliation of physical currency limits.
narrative_spec: Reframe the exact counting of nickels and pennies on a wet convenience store counter not as a moment of defeat, but as a high-stakes mathematical ritual. Focus on the physical texture of worn copper, the weight of a line forming behind the speaker, and the cold gaze of the fluorescent lights.

title: Overtime and the Sinking Sun
core_theme: The trade of biological time for survival.
narrative_spec: Write from the perspective of an hourly worker watching the horizon through a high warehouse window during an unrequested shift. Describe the exhaustion in the lower back and shoulders. The setting sun should be treated as a disappearing asset, a currency that cannot be saved or reinvested.

title: The Anatomy of the Late Fee
core_theme: The compounding penalty of poverty.
narrative_spec: Animate the administrative machinery of a bank or utility company's automated penalty system. Focus on the cold..

title: Rust and the Commuter’s Liturgy
core_theme: The mechanical fragility of a livelihood.
narrative_spec: Focus entirely on the sound of an uncertain engine turning over on a freezing winter morning. Think of the physical rituals, and desperate bargaining to stay functional.

title: The Calculus of the Defrosted Freezer
core_theme: The preservation of perishable resources.
narrative_spec: Document the quiet panic of a household food inventory following a minor power outage or a broken appliance seal. Reframe the melting ice and softening proteins not merely as spoiled groceries, but as a rapid, uncontainable leak of hard labor and calculated calories. Use sensory details of cold water pooling on linoleum.

title: Graveyard Shift Hagiography
core_theme: The inversion of natural circadian rhythm for low-wage utility.
narrative_spec: Examine the surreal, liminal landscape of an industrial park or a twenty-four-hour cleaning crew at 3:00 AM. Elevate the mundane tools—the industrial mop, the heavy chemical scent of ammonia, the humming floor buffer—into sacred instruments of a forgotten order. The workers are saints operating in a world empty of observers.

title: The Metric of the Half-Tank
core_theme: Geography bounded by fuel limitations.
narrative_spec: Map a city entirely through the lens of a fuel gauge that never passes the halfway mark. Explore how economic constraints shrink the physical world.

title: Lien on the Horizon
core_theme: The structural ownership of future labor.
narrative_spec: Analyze the signing of a predatory loan or a high-interest subprime contract. Treat the ink of the signature as an invasive vine that roots itself into the speaker’s upcoming decade. The poem must avoid melodrama, focusing instead on the quiet, bureaucratic silence of the office and the absolute certainty of the math.

title: The Uniform's Weight
core_theme: The erasure of identity through industrial textiles.
narrative_spec: Examine the physical sensation of putting on a cheap, polyester company uniform that doesn't fit correctly. Focus on the texture of the synthetic fabric against skin, the static electricity, and the way the company logo acts as a brand that alters the wearer’s posture and social visibility in public spaces.

title: Inventory of the Broken Tool
core_theme: The sudden loss of the means of production.
narrative_spec: A tradesperson or independent laborer discovers their primary piece of equipment—a saw, a sewing machine, a laptop—has suffered a terminal failure. Detail the object with visceral realism.

title: The Architecture of the Waiting Room
core_theme: Time as a weapon of institutional indifference.
narrative_spec: Set the poem entirely within a state social services office or a free clinic. Focus on the specific architecture of scarcity: the fixed plastic chairs, the frosted glass barrier between the public and the bureaucracy, and the way minutes are drawn out and degraded as a form of currency extracted from those in need.

title: Stitch-Count Capitalism
core_theme: The micro-measurement of human physical output.
narrative_spec: Focus on a pieceworker or warehouse picker whose performance is monitored by a digital algorithm or a stopwatch-wielding supervisor. Reframe the body as a complex machine being driven past its friction limits.

title: The Epistemology of the Thrift Store Coat
core_theme: Inherited warmth and anonymous history.
narrative_spec: Trace the history of a heavy, secondhand winter coat bought out of necessity. Explore the remnants left by its previous owner, a deep pocket stain, a lingering scent.

title: Eviction Notice as Epistolary Poem
core_theme: The fragile legal definition of shelter.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the physical document of a three-day notice taped to a front door. Contrast the clinical, dispassionate legal jargon of the text with the intimate, lived reality of the space behind the door.

title: The Breadline Metronome
core_theme: The rhythm of collective waiting for subsistence.
narrative_spec: Capture the sensory landscape of a food pantry line during early morning rain. Focus on the sounds

title: Subletting the Self
core_theme: The commodification of physical safety and space.
narrative_spec: Focus on the experience of living in an overcrowded apartment, sharing a single bedroom with multiple shifts of workers, or renting out an uninsulated garage. Explore the loss of privacy not as a psychological tragedy, but as a spatial economic compromise where human breath must be rationed by the square foot.

title: The Intermittent Wi-Fi Oracle
core_theme: The digital divide as a barrier to survival infrastructure.
narrative_spec: A speaker sits in a fast-food parking lot at night to use the free internet connection to complete a job application or a remote assignment.

title: The Maintenance of the Used Shoe
core_theme: The physical erosion of labor infrastructure.
narrative_spec: Examine the specific wear patterns on the soles of work boots or service shoes that cannot yet be replaced. Use detailed sensory language to describe the thinning rubber, the application of cheap adhesive or duct tape to hold the welt together, and the intimate knowledge a walker has of every uneven crack in the pavement.

title: The Ledger of the Unpaid Favor
core_theme: Mutual aid as an informal, high-stakes economy.
narrative_spec: Explore the, unwritten system of debts, rides, child care shifts, and borrowed tools among neighbors in an under-resourced neighborhood.

title: The Broken Shift-Schedule
core_theme: The instability of dynamic on-call employment.
narrative_spec: Capture the specific text message notification received at midnight canceling a shift scheduled for the following morning.

title: The Tip-Jar Eulogy
core_theme: The reliance on volatile human whims for basic sustenance.
narrative_spec: Focus on the physical container that a service job. Any container is fine.

title: The Last Five Dollars in the ATM
core_theme: The absolute boundary of formal banking.
narrative_spec: The poem takes place at an ATM that refuses to dispense a single, remaining low digit balance due to structural machine limits.
